card.name: Mixed spots before combined or added effects
card.fires_on: Scattered spots in drug-label text: inside drug names like cyclophosphamide and benzodiazepines, and small words just before additive-effect or make-up-to-volume wording. No single word type holds across all of them.

modes.label: Inside drug names
modes.description: Partway through long drug names such as cyclophosphamide or benzodiazepines.
modes.example: concurrent cyclo<<ph>>osphamide therapy is not recommended

modes.label: Before additive effect
modes.description: Small words just before wording about combined or additive effects on risk.
modes.example: Coadministration of antiplatelet agents increase<< the>> risk of bleeding due to an additive effect

modes.label: Preparation and dilution
modes.description: Words in mixing and dilution steps that lead to a final volume or concentration.
modes.example: a sufficient<< quantity>> to make 1000 ml

card.writes: It slightly favors odd code-like tokens and suppresses words like complement and complementary, with no clear meaning.
